scripts.bootstrap: uv sync --all-packages && pnpm install && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed && pnpm reindex
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --directory services/commerce alembic upgrade head && uv run --directory services/assistant assistant-migrate
scripts.contracts: uv run --directory services/commerce commerce-openapi && pnpm --filter @ai-commerce/contracts generate
scripts.lint: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && pnpm --filter @ai-commerce/web lint
scripts.typecheck: uv run mypy services/commerce/src services/assistant/src packages/telemetry/src packages/retrieval/src services/planner/src packages/assistant-stream/src services/voice/src && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:retrieval && pnpm test:planner && pnpm test:stream && pnpm test:voice && pnpm --filter @ai-commerce/web test
scripts.test:unit: uv run --directory services/commerce pytest tests/unit -q && uv run --directory services/assistant pytest tests/unit -q
scripts.test:integration: uv run --directory services/commerce pytest tests/integration -q && uv run --directory services/assistant pytest tests/integration -q
